worked_solution:
To find the $y$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(x+3)^{2}}{9}-\frac{(y-5)^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{(0+3)^{2}}{9}-\frac{(y-5)^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ 1-\frac{(y-5)^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ -\frac{(y-5)^{2}}{25} & =0 \\ (y-5)^{2} & =0 \\ y-5 & =0 \\ y & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $y$-intercept is $(0,5).$
